section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines five research hypotheses for a single study. The study aims to validate the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in Black college women and investigate the role of ethnic identity in body appreciation. It hypothesizes a unidimensional factor structure for BAS, positive correlations with appearance satisfaction and self-esteem, negative correlations with Western beauty ideal internalization and eating disorder behaviors, and relationships between BAS, ethnic identity, and eating disorder symptoms mediated by Western beauty ideal internalization.
